t: ВС РФ поразили DATA-центры, предприятия и логистические центры на Украине
d: Российские войска поразили в ночь на 11 сентября украинские логистические центры, объекты портовой инфраструктуры и суда, которые доставляли военные грузы. Об этом сообщили в Минобороны РФ.

de: On the night of September 11, Russian troops struck Ukrainian logistics centers, port infrastructure facilities and ships that delivered military cargo. This was reported in the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation.

d: В Приморском крае несоблюдение большегрузным автомобилем дистанции привело к массовому дорожно-транспортному происшествию, в котором получили травмы и были госпитализированы три человека, сообщает УМВД региона.

de: In the Primorsky Territory, the failure of a heavy truck to observe the distance led to a mass road accident, in which three people were injured and hospitalized, the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the region reports.

d: Четырехтомник, посвященный истории и современности Беларуси, изданный на русском и английском языках, был представлен в Доме приемов государственной библиотеки иностранной литературы имени Рудомино, информирует БЕЛТА.

de: A four-volume book dedicated to the history and modernity of Belarus, published in Russian and English, was presented in the Reception House of the Rudomino State Library of Foreign Literature.

t: Над регионами России ночью сбили 777 беспилотников. Что известно о последствиях атаки
d: Российские средства противовоздушной обороны за минувшую ночь сбили над территорией РФ 777 украинских беспилотников. Об этом сообщается в утренней сводке Минобороны РФ.
te: Over the regions of Russia at night shot down 777 drones.
de: Russian air defense systems over the past night shot down over the territory of the Russian Federation 777 Ukrainian drones. This is reported in the morning summary of the Ministry of Defense of the Russian Federation.

t: Россиянин скончался на рейсе из Москвы в Нячанг, экстренно севшем в Самарканде

te: The Russian died on a flight from Moscow to Nha Trang, urgently settled in Samarkand
de: A Russian citizen died on Friday morning, September 11, after an emergency landing in Samarkand of a plane flying from Moscow to Nha Trang (Vietnam). This is reported by RIA Novosti with reference to an employee of the local air harbor.

de: The SBU and the police in the Chernihiv region have strengthened control over the flight of residents of Ukraine to Belarus, writes TASS with reference to Russian law enforcement agencies.

de: The court of the Soviet district of Omsk has convicted a 38-year-old local resident who attacked an elderly woman who stood up for a homeless dog.

te: In the Crimea increased fuel reserves at a reduced price
de: In the Republic of Crimea and Sevastopol on September 11, fuel at a reduced price of up to 100 rubles will arrive at 130 filling stations.

de: The world-famous Bashkir ethnogroup AY YOLA presented a new song called "Amanat". The premiere of the composition took place today, September 11.

de: In the village of Krasnoyarka in the Serov municipal district, the boiler house was transferred to biofuel. This is a pilot project, which, if successful, will be scaled to facilities in other settlements.

d: В России впервые запущены коммерческие сети связи пятого поколения. На первом этапе сервисы 5G заработали в 16 городах, доступ к высокоскоростному мобильному интернету получили около 10 млн человек. Об этом сообщили в Минцифры.

de: In Russia, for the first time launched commercial communication networks of the fifth generation. At the first stage, 5G services were launched in 16 cities, about 10 million people got access to high-speed mobile Internet. This was reported to the Ministry of information.

de: In the forests near Moscow finally came the mushroom season: there are white, podsinovyki, butter. And now is the time to go for autumn smacks, said expert Dmitry Tikhomirov.

de: Minsk is ready to negotiate with Washington on serious issues. But first, the United States must return to Belarus $43-44 million of “stuck” funds in the United States. This was stated by the President of the Republic Alexander Lukashenko on Friday

de: The US Central Intelligence Agency has declassified an array of data related to the September 11, 2001 attacks. The documents appeared on the agency's website.

de: If Western countries decide to send their troops to Ukraine, it will mean war with Russia, Russian President Vladimir Putin told reporters in New Delhi during a visit to India.
